results.title: Resin Recharge Rate and Resin Cap Guide | Genshin Impact｜Game8
results.content:
The Resin Recharge Rate is 1 Resin per 8 minutes, which yields a total of 7 resins an hour. This is a pretty lengthy time but not all activities consume Original Resin, and it also recovers while the game is closed. Make sure to always spend Original Resin in time to maximize its use!

In Version 4.7 Developers Discussion, the resin cap is increased from 160 to 200, which means the resin recharge rate now takes 26 hours for the entire resin counter to fully replenish! [...] Fragile Resin is an item used to restore Original Resin without spending Primogems. Each Fragile Resin is worth 60 Original Resin. You can get these from Events, the Battle Pass, and Adventure Rank level ups!

How to Get Fragile Resin and Effects

### Restore with Transient Resin [...] Original Resin is best used to farm Leyline Outcrops for Hero's Wit and other Character EXP Material, or Challenge Domains for Talent Ascension Materials, Artifacts, and Weapon Ascension Materials.

### Convert into Condensed Resin

You can store up to 200 Original Resin for later use by converting it into Condensed Resin, at a maximum of 5. Once converted, you will be able to save resin for Domains and Ley Lines and use them on another day!
